_comment: Hardware config. PE_peak and GEMM_peak are in TFLOPS. PE_utilization is a fraction (0..1) applied only to PE_peak (non-GEMM ops), not to GEMM_peak. throughput is the per-cluster wall-clock budget in ms, now interpreted as compute time + transfer time (omit to skip cluster splitting). bandwidth_gbs is the inter-cluster/HBM bandwidth in GB/s used to estimate transfer time = bytes/(bandwidth_gbs*1e6) ms (omit or 0 to count compute only). frequency is the clock frequency in Hz.
